name: Strand
comment: Grammar for the Strand language. The token surface mirrors crates/strandc/src/lexer.rs; the widget vocabulary mirrors the BUILDERS table at crates/strandc/src/ui.rs:181. Keep both in sync when the compiler changes.

comment.comment: lexer.rs:226 -- line comments only; no block comments exist in Strand.
comment.name: comment.line.double-slash.strand

string.comment: lexer.rs:301 -- double quotes only. A newline inside a string is a hard lexer error (lexer.rs:310), so the string ends at the line break as well as at the closing quote.
string.name: string.quoted.double.strand

patterns.comment: lexer.rs:315-324 -- these five escapes are the complete legal set.
patterns.name: constant.character.escape.strand

patterns.comment: Anything else after a backslash is a compile error, including \0, \x41 and \u{...}.
patterns.name: invalid.illegal.unknown-escape.strand

patterns.comment: lexer.rs:277-279 -- a dot only joins the number when a DIGIT follows, so 1.max(2) must lex as int, dot, ident. This rule must precede the integer rule.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.float.strand

patterns.comment: Decimal only -- no 0x/0b/0o, no exponent, no suffix. Underscores allowed.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.integer.strand

view-modifier.comment: lexer.rs:261 -- view is unconditionally Tok::View, so it is never a legal identifier. parser.rs rejects 'view fn view(...)' outright: '`view` is a keyword, not a name'. Scope it as a keyword everywhere.
view-modifier.name: storage.modifier.view.strand

patterns.comment: lexer.rs:262-263 -- lexed today, not yet consumed by the parser. Reserved for structured concurrency (design doc 4.4).
patterns.name: keyword.other.reserved.strand

patterns.comment: check.rs:441-476 -- Node plus the generic built-ins.
patterns.name: support.type.strand

builtin-function.comment: hir.rs:258-261 -- log is the entire Builtin enum.
builtin-function.name: support.function.builtin.strand

widget.comment: The closed BUILDERS table at ui.rs:181-243. Containers (screen/column/row/panel/scroll) take a trailing block; the rest are leaves. Add new names here when ui.rs gains a widget.
widget.name: support.function.widget.strand

constructor.comment: lexer.rs:29-30 -- these are ordinary identifiers to the lexer, resolved as constructors by the checker.
constructor.name: support.constant.constructor.strand

wildcard.comment: parser.rs:680 -- _ is a normal identifier everywhere except pattern position.
wildcard.name: variable.language.wildcard.strand

label.comment: parser.rs:520 -- labelled call arguments (gap: 8), record type fields (title: string) and the actor state:/message: clauses are lexically identical. The parser separates them with lookahead; a regex grammar cannot, so all three share one scope deliberately.
label.name: variable.other.property.strand

capitalized.comment: parser.rs:700-706 -- capitalised bare names are niladic constructors, lowercase ones bind. Covers user types and sum-type variants alike.
capitalized.name: entity.name.type.strand

patterns.comment: parser.rs:258-281 -- | only ever separates sum-type variants. Strand has no bitwise or.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.variant.strand

patterns.comment: Postfix try on expressions, and postfix Option sugar on types (string?), which stacks.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.try.strand

patterns.comment: lexer.rs:389-392 -- a lone & is a hard error: Strand has no bitwise operators. && is already claimed by the logical rule above.
patterns.name: invalid.illegal.ampersand.strand

patterns.comment: No sigils exist in Strand; each of these is an 'unexpected character' lexer error. Single quote included because Strand has no char literals.
patterns.name: invalid.illegal.character.strand
